datasets.name: TransactionData
datasets.sql:
select 
     pr.dat,
     pr.no_prov,
     pr.vid_op,
     pr.val_acc,
     pr.rate_d,
     pr.debt,
     pr.currencyid_c,
     pr.rate_c,
     pr.kredit,
     pr.ammount,
     pr.ammount_c,
     pr.lammount,
     pr.kassa_b,
     pr.kassa_z,
     pr.name
from 
    provarch pr
where ID = :TransactionID  

union 

select 
     lr.dat,
     lr.no_prov,
     lr.vid_op,
     lr.val_acc,
     lr.rate_d,
     lr.debt,
     lr.currencyid_c,
     lr.rate_c,
     lr.kredit,
     lr.ammount,
     lr.ammount_c,
     lr.lammount,
     lr.kassa_b,
     lr.kassa_z,
     lr.name
from 
    lazytransaction lr
where ID = :TransactionID

datasets.name: AvaluteDebit
datasets.sql:
select valute,valu_name from avalute
where valute = :valute

datasets.name: AvaluteCredit
datasets.sql:
select valute,valu_name from avalute
where valute = :valute

datasets.name: AccDebit
datasets.sql:
select id,acc_no,name from account
where id = :ID

datasets.name: AccCredit
datasets.sql:
select id,acc_no,name from account
where id = :ID

datasets.name: RestCredit
datasets.sql:
select acc_id,
       nvl(abs(ostat),0) as ostat,
       nvl(abs(pok_ostat),0) as pok_ostat
from archost 
where acc_id = :acc_id
and datdate = :dat

datasets.name: operations
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, name
  FROM vid_op

where id = :ID

datasets.name: CashSymbols
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  symbol,
  name
FROM
  kassa_b
where symbol = :symbol

datasets.name: RestDebit
datasets.sql:
select acc_id,

from archost
